summary: wenzhenxiang 提出 ERC-8112 与 ERC-8114，为智能合约钱包定义链下签名的代币与 NFT 转账流程，任何中继者都可提交，规定 EIP-712 模式与 nonce 管理。nerolation 澄清 EIP-7928 BAL 中 7702 授权失败但授权账户尚未被访问时的处理，提交并合并。

items.title: Magicians：ERC-8112 签名代币转账

summary_en: wenzhenxiang proposed ERC-8112 and ERC-8114, offchain signed token and NFT transfer flows for smart contract wallets that any relayer can submit, with an EIP-712 schema and nonce accounting. nerolation clarified in EIP-7928 BAL how a failed 7702 authorization is handled when the authority account was not yet accessed, submitted and merged.
